title: The Four Day Texas Method
author: O P.
desc:
This is a modified version of the classic Texas Method. It’s set up as a four day upper/lower split and also includes some accessories with low volume and high intensity for those who like to push hard on their accessories.  

VOLUME SQUAT BENCH AND DEADLIFT
The weight for squat, bench, and deadlift volume on days 1 and 2 should be 70-73% of your 1RM. I recommend starting out at 70% on the first week. Volume is going to be the key factor in making this program work, so if the volume work is beating you up or making you not progress on your intensity days, decrease the weight instead of decreasing your sets. Increase the weight on these days only every 2-3 weeks.

INTENSITY SQUAT BENCH AND DEADLIFT
The weight for squat, bench, and deadlift intensity on days 3 and 4 should be 82-83% of your 1RM. Increase the weight on these days every week. Bench should only be 2.5-5 pounds every week, while squat and deadlift can be increased 5-10 pounds a week. If progress stalls on these days on any of the three lifts, decrease 5RM to 3RM. If progress stalls on 3RM, reset up to 5RM.
